maudhui: (1) Apart from the provisions of Article 30(2), an Act of Parliament shall not be invalid for the reason only that it provides for the taking of measures during a state of emergency that derogate from the provisions of Articles 14 and 15 of this Constitution. (2) No measures referred to in subarticle (1) shall be taken in pursuance of any law during a state of emergency save only to the extent that they are necessary and justifiable for dealing with the situation that exists during the state of emergency. (3) Nothing in this Article shall be construed to authorize the deprivation of a person's right to live except in respect of deaths resulting from acts of war. (4) No measures referred to in this Article shall be taken in pursuance of any law during a state of emergency in relation to any person save only to the extent that they are necessary and justifiable for dealing with the situation that exists during the state of emergency.
